about: Manuals that ship with ELMER. Only public releases go here: a book whose cover carries Distribution Statement A - the words 'Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited', which the Army prints under the label 'Distribution Restriction' - or one in the public domain outright. Each entry is copied from the book's own cover and title page: file, title, edition, the release statement word for word, the publisher's record for that edition, and the SHA-256 and size of the file exactly as the publisher serves it, never re-saved or recompressed. tests/test_shelf.py fails if a file is missing, unlisted, or no longer matches its hash. Total kept under 40 MB.
